description: This file defines the `HTMLPurifier_ChildDef_Chameleon` class, which manages definitions for inline and block context-dependent HTML tags, specifically handling the `del` and `ins` tags. It allows dynamic validation based on context, enabling different allowed child elements in inline versus block modes.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_ChildDef_Chameleon
classes.description: Class that switches between inline and block child element definitions depending on context, mainly used for tags like del and ins that can behave differently in inline versus block contexts.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes inline and block definitions based on provided element lists.

methods.name: validateChildren
methods.description: Validates child nodes depending on whether the current context is inline or block, delegating to the appropriate definition.
